items.question: 어제 순 방문자 수는?
최근 7일 일별 페이지뷰 추이를 보여줘
items.sql:
SELECT
    summary_date AS date,
    SUM(page_views) AS daily_page_views
FROM agg_page_daily
WHERE summary_date >= current_date - 7
  AND summary_date < current_date
GROUP BY summary_date
ORDER BY summary_date;

items.question: 최근 30일 동안 이벤트 종류별 발생 건수는?
items.sql:
SELECT
    event_name,
    SUM(event_count) AS total_event_count
FROM agg_event_daily
WHERE summary_date >= current_date - 30
  AND summary_date <  current_date
GROUP BY event_name
ORDER BY total_event_count DESC;

items.question: 지난주 페이지뷰가 가장 많은 페이지 5개는?

    page_path AS page_path,
    SUM(page_views) AS page_views_last_week
FROM agg_page_daily
WHERE summary_date >= date_trunc('week', current_date)::date - 7
  AND summary_date <  date_trunc('week', current_date)::date
GROUP BY page_path

items.question: 지난주 유입 소스(traffic_source)별 세션 수는?
지난주 유입 소스(traffic_source)별 이탈률(%)은?
items.sql:
SELECT
    COALESCE(traffic_source, 'unknown') AS traffic_source,
    SUM(bounced_sessions) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(sessions), 0) AS bounce_rate_percent
FROM agg_traffic_hourly
WHERE summary_date >= date_trunc('week', current_date)::date - 7
  AND summary_date < date_trunc('week', current_date)::date
GROUP BY traffic_source
ORDER BY bounce_rate_percent DESC;

items.question: 최근 7일 연령대별 평균 세션 시간(초)은?
items.sql:
SELECT
    age_group,
    CASE 
        WHEN SUM(sessions) = 0 THEN NULL
        ELSE (SUM(session_duration_sum)::numeric / SUM(sessions))
    END AS average_session_seconds
FROM agg_user_session_daily
WHERE summary_date >= current_date - 7
  AND summary_date < current_date
GROUP BY age_group
ORDER BY age_group;

items.question: 최근 7일 nov_mega_sale 캠페인의 유입 소스·매체별 세션 수와 전환 수는?
items.sql:
SELECT
    traffic_source AS source,
    traffic_medium AS medium,
    SUM(sessions)      AS sessions,
    SUM(conversions)   AS conversions
FROM agg_traffic_hourly
WHERE summary_date >= current_date - 7
  AND summary_date < current_date
  AND traffic_campaign = 'nov_mega_sale'
GROUP BY traffic_source, traffic_medium
ORDER BY sessions DESC
LIMIT 1000;

items.question: 최근 7일 페이지뷰 100회 이상인 페이지 중 평균 체류 시간(초)이 가장 긴 5개는?
items.sql:
SELECT
    page_path,
    SUM(page_views) AS total_page_views,
    SUM(time_on_page_sum)::numeric / NULLIF(SUM(page_views), 0) AS avg_time_on_page_seconds
FROM agg_page_daily
WHERE summary_date >= current_date - 7
  AND summary_date < current_date
GROUP BY page_path
HAVING SUM(page_views) >= 100
ORDER BY avg_time_on_page_seconds DESC
LIMIT 5;

items.question: 15일 전 기기 유형별로 /checkout/success 페이지를 본 세션 수는?
items.sql:
SELECT
    device_type AS device_type,
    COUNT(DISTINCT session_id) AS sessions
FROM events
WHERE timestamp >= current_date - interval '15 days'
  AND timestamp < current_date - interval '14 days'
  AND event_name = 'page_view'
  AND page_path = '/checkout/success'
GROUP BY device_type
ORDER BY device_type;

items.question: 지난주 대비 이번 주 유입 소스(traffic_source)별 세션 수를 비교해줘
items.sql:
WITH this_week AS (
    SELECT traffic_source,
           SUM(sessions) AS sessions_this_week
    FROM agg_traffic_hourly
    WHERE summary_date >= date_trunc('week', current_date)::date
      AND summary_date <= current_date
    GROUP BY traffic_source
),
last_week AS (
    SELECT traffic_source,
           SUM(sessions) AS sessions_last_week
    FROM agg_traffic_hourly
    WHERE summary_date >= date_trunc('week', current_date)::date - 7
      AND summary_date < date_trunc('week', current_date)::date
    GROUP BY traffic_source
)
SELECT COALESCE(t.traffic_source, l.traffic_source) AS traffic_source,
       COALESCE(t.sessions_this_week, 0) AS sessions_this_week,
       COALESCE(l.sessions_last_week, 0) AS sessions_last_week
FROM this_week t
FULL OUTER JOIN last_week l USING (traffic_source)
ORDER BY traffic_source;

items.question: 지난주 세션 100개 이상인 유입 소스·매체 중 전환율(%)이 가장 높은 3개는?
items.sql:
SELECT
    traffic_source,
    traffic_medium,
    SUM(sessions) AS sessions,
    SUM(conversions) AS conversions,
    ROUND(SUM(conversions)::numeric * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(sessions), 0), 2) AS conversion_rate_percent
FROM agg_traffic_hourly
WHERE summary_date >= date_trunc('week', current_date)::date - 7
  AND summary_date < date_trunc('week', current_date)::date
GROUP BY traffic_source, traffic_medium
HAVING SUM(sessions) >= 100
ORDER BY conversion_rate_percent DESC
LIMIT 3;

items.question: 최근 28일 동안 요일별(ISO 요일 번호, 월=1) 하루 평균 세션 수는?
items.sql:
WITH daily_sessions AS (
    SELECT
        summary_date,
        SUM(sessions) AS total_sessions
    FROM agg_user_session_daily
    WHERE summary_date >= current_date - 28
      AND summary_date < current_date
    GROUP BY summary_date
)
SELECT
    EXTRACT(ISODOW FROM summary_date)::int AS iso_weekday,
    ROUND(AVG(total_sessions)::numeric, 2)    AS avg_sessions
FROM daily_sessions
GROUP BY iso_weekday
ORDER BY iso_weekday;

items.question: 최근 7일 기기 유형별 결제 전환율(%)을 알려줘. 결제(is_payment) 이벤트가 있었던 세션의 비율로 계산해줘
items.sql:
SELECT
    device_type,
    (COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN event_name = 'is_payment' THEN session_id END) * 100.0
     / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT session_id), 0)) AS conversion_rate_percent
FROM events
WHERE timestamp >= current_date - 7
  AND timestamp < current_date
GROUP BY device_type
ORDER BY device_type;

items.question: 최근 7일과 그 전 7일의 일평균 순 방문자 수를 비교해줘
items.reason: 전치 허용: 정답의 열을 행으로 반환
items.sql:
WITH daily_counts AS (
  SELECT
    summary_date,
    COUNT(DISTINCT client_id) AS visitors,
    CASE
      WHEN summary_date >= current_date - 7 AND summary_date < current_date THEN 'recent_7d'
      WHEN summary_date >= current_date - 14 AND summary_date < current_date - 7 THEN 'previous_7d'
    END AS period
  FROM agg_daily_users
  WHERE summary_date >= current_date - 14
    AND summary_date < current_date
  GROUP BY summary_date
)
SELECT
  period,
  ROUND(AVG(visitors)::numeric, 2) AS avg_daily_visitors
FROM daily_counts
GROUP BY period
ORDER BY period;

items.question: 지난주 대비 이번 주 이벤트 종류별 발생 건수 변화를 보여줘
items.sql:
WITH this_week AS (
  SELECT event_name,
         SUM(event_count) AS this_week_count
  FROM agg_event_daily
  WHERE summary_date >= date_trunc('week', current_date)::date
    AND summary_date < (date_trunc('week', current_date) + interval '7 days')::date
  GROUP BY event_name
),
last_week AS (
  SELECT event_name,
         SUM(event_count) AS last_week_count
  FROM agg_event_daily
  WHERE summary_date >= (date_trunc('week', current_date) - interval '7 days')::date
    AND summary_date < date_trunc('week', current_date)::date
  GROUP BY event_name
)
SELECT COALESCE(t.event_name, l.event_name)          AS event_name,
       COALESCE(t.this_week_count, 0)                AS this_week_count,
       COALESCE(l.last_week_count, 0)                AS last_week_count,
       (COALESCE(t.this_week_count, 0) -
        COALESCE(l.last_week_count, 0))               AS diff_count,
       CASE
         WHEN COALESCE(l.last_week_count, 0) = 0 THEN NULL
         ELSE ROUND(((COALESCE(t.this_week_count, 0) -
                     COALESCE(l.last_week_count, 0))::numeric /
                     l.last_week_count) * 100, 2)
       END                                            AS pct_change
FROM this_week t
FULL OUTER JOIN last_week l USING (event_name)
ORDER BY event_name;

items.question: 지난주 신규 방문자 수와 재방문자 수는?
items.reason: 정답 2번째 컬럼과 값이 같은 컬럼이 없음
items.sql:
WITH
    period AS (
        SELECT 
            date_trunc('week', current_date)::date - 7 AS start_date,
            date_trunc('week', current_date)::date       AS end_date
    ),
    first_visits AS (
        SELECT client_id, MIN(summary_date) AS first_date
        FROM agg_daily_users
        GROUP BY client_id
    ),
    last_week_active AS (
        SELECT DISTINCT client_id
        FROM agg_daily_users a
        CROSS JOIN period p
        WHERE a.summary_date >= p.start_date
          AND a.summary_date <  p.end_date
    )
SELECT
    SUM(CASE 
            WHEN fv.first_date >= p.start_date 
             AND fv.first_date <  p.end_date THEN 1 
            ELSE 0 
        END) AS new_visitors,
    SUM(CASE 
            WHEN fv.first_date < p.start_date THEN 1 
            ELSE 0 
        END) AS returning_visitors
FROM last_week_active l
JOIN first_visits fv ON fv.client_id = l.client_id
CROSS JOIN period p;
